name: Sketch to Photo
summary: Converts 2D fashion sketches to photorealistic renders using Gemini analysis and Nano Banana rendering

inputs.description: 2D fashion sketch to convert to photorealistic render

outputs.description: Photorealistic render of the fashion sketch

executionNotes: This node uses a 2-step pipeline: (1) Gemini Flash analyzes the sketch and generates a detailed description, (2) Nano Banana renders a photorealistic image from that description using the sketch as reference. Processing time varies based on sketch complexity and API response times.

exampleConnections.scenario: Connect an image input node containing a fashion sketch
